blurb: Shaka Wasaga Boat Cruise is a unique experience making you feel like you’re cruising the waters of the tropics. With the white sandy beaches, crystal clear waters of the Georgian Bay and breathtaking sunsets on the water, you’ll forget you’re here in your own backyard. We want to help you create your lifetime memory with friends and family giving you a new flavour to your typical boating
